answer: Proof-of-burn deters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to destroy base currency to register a valid identity. For haulers operating between a coastal wharf and an umber ore ledge, peers accept task bids only when linked to verifiable on-chain burn transactions. This forces adversaries to sacrifice scarce, non-refundable capital per created persona. However, destroying assets drains circulating liquidity and creates high barriers for low-capital micro-agents.
